pr_title: Detect full references to issues and pulls in commit messages
pr_comments:
Did not seem to work with:

``` bash
git commit --allow-empty -m 'xxx - fixes: http://localhost:3500/test/test/issues/1'
```
but this did:

``` bash
git commit --allow-empty -m 'xxx - fixes: #1'
```
Sorry @silverwind looks like that was an initially failed attempt. The problem was that I was looking in the wrong place - I'll leave the other fix in place though.

issue_context.title: Issue does not close via `Fixes: <url>`
issue_context.body:
Pushing with `Fixes: https://gitea/user/repo/issues/1` in a commit message does not close a issue while `Fixes: #1` does.

The interface correctly displays a `#1` link in place of the URL. I think URLs should be resolved first before passing the string to the issue number matcher.
